label: Original-phase input of 2 (or n/0/h/w/i/l/u/g after an earlier r/c/3/f/d/t)
explanation: Distributed candidate-low coordinate that behaves like an additive code over current input and prefix contents. 84% of activation mass is in the original (input) phase, peaking at t=2-4. The current input matters most: 2 fires on 33% of its steps (6.5x lift, 21% of mass), then n, 0 (3.3x), h, w, i, l, u, g. Earlier tokens add to it: when the prefix (especially the first token) contains r, c, 3, f or d, activation is larger, and the top examples are all 2 or n arriving after r/c tokens (e.g. r r r 2 -> 0.98 of max). Weak residual firing at <DEL> and in the copy phase, where outputs r, c, 3 raise it. It rarely fires on b, x, j, e, y and is weak at t=0 and late in long copies. No single clean predicate: dev F1 about 0.44, mass recall 0.69. The bare 2-input clause has precision 0.58 but only 21% of mass.
